# Implementation Tasks: Multi-User Todo Application with AI Chatbot

**Feature**: Multi-User Todo Application with AI Chatbot  
**Branch**: 002-todo-ai-chatbot  
**Created**: 2026-02-09  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/002-todo-ai-chatbot/spec.md`

**Note**: This file is generated by the `/sp.tasks` command. See `.specify/templates/commands/tasks.md` for the generation workflow.

## Implementation Strategy

Build the application in priority order of user stories, starting with the foundational elements needed for all stories. Each user story will be implemented as a complete, independently testable increment. The implementation will follow an MVP-first approach, delivering core functionality early and iterating on advanced features.

### MVP Scope
The MVP will include User Story 1 (Web-Based Todo Management) with basic authentication, task CRUD operations, and a responsive UI. This provides the core value proposition of the application.

### Delivery Approach
1. Phase 1: Project setup and foundational infrastructure
2. Phase 2: Core data models and authentication
3. Phase 3: User Story 1 (P1) - Web-based todo management
4. Phase 4: User Story 3 (P3) - Secure API access
5. Phase 5: User Story 2 (P2) - AI-powered chatbot
6. Phase 6: Polish and cross-cutting concerns

## Dependencies

- User Story 1 (P1) must be completed before User Story 2 (P2) as the AI chatbot relies on the core todo functionality
- User Story 3 (P3) can be implemented in parallel with User Story 1 (P1) as it focuses on API access to the same underlying functionality
- User Story 2 (P2) depends on both User Story 1 (P1) and User Story 3 (P3) for the MCP tools and API infrastructure

## Parallel Execution Examples

Within each user story, the following tasks can be executed in parallel:
- UI components and API endpoints
- Service layer implementations for different entities
- Unit tests for different modules

## Phase 3: User Story 1 - Web-Based Todo Management (Priority: P1)

### Goal
Enable users to sign up, sign in, and manage their todo tasks through a responsive web interface. Users can create, read, update, and delete tasks, as well as mark tasks as complete/incomplete.

### Independent Test Criteria
Can be fully tested by registering a user account, creating tasks, viewing the task list, updating tasks, and deleting tasks. Delivers the core value of a todo management system.
